page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a virtual workstation server built on KVM hypervisor architecture. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock frequency of 2.9 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Memory allocation stands at 32.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with a partitioned NVIDIA A10 GPU representing a 0.3333 GPU allocation with 8 GB of total VRAM. It has no local NVMe storage and relies on external storage, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance tests place the server in the middle percentile across general CPU and memory tasks. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1590.0 and a multi-core score of 12813.0, supported by a PassMark CPU score of 29573.87 and stress-ng multi-core throughput of 28120.76. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 77.1 GB/sec, while write operations peak at 51.61 GB/sec. For machine learning tasks, the instance achieves LLM inference text generation speeds of 243.2 tokens/sec on a small 135M model and 12.06 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model. Static web serving throughput reaches 20.48 GB/sec.

The fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU setup offers resource-efficient GPU acceleration for workloads that do not require a full dedicated graphics card. A key operational tradeoff is the lack of bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage over the 5 Gbps network link. This configuration fits virtual desktop infrastructure, remote workstation rendering, light AI inference, and cloud graphics applications.

The instance features 32.0 GB of System RAM alongside a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM (0.3333 GPU allocation). It includes a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and no attached local storage. Synthetic benchmarks indicate average performance across single-core and multi-core CPU workloads, with a PassMark CPU score of 29573.87 and Geekbench multi-core score of 12813.0. In LLM inference tests, it achieves 243.2 tokens per second generation on a 135M parameter model and 12.06 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model. The combination of fractional GPU access and dedicated Intel compute makes this server suitable for virtual desktop infrastructure, light AI inference, media processing, and graphics-assisted development environments.
